newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe Steel plans nine bln yen mill refurbishment.
newsitem.headline: Kobe Steel plans nine bln yen mill refurbishment.

text.p: Kobe Steel Ltd said on Thursday it plans to spend nine billion yen to refurbish a wire rod mill at its Kakogawa steel plant in Hyogo prefecture, western Japan.
Kobe Steel's steel wire rod products are produced at its Kobe plant and Kakogawa plant, both in Hyogo prefecture.
In September last year, Kobe Steel said it planned to remodel a wire rod mill at the Kobe plant, also at a cost of nine billion yen.
Construction at the Kakogawa plant will start in January 1998 and the mill will resume full production in May 1999, Kobe said.
The wire rod produced at the mill is used to make tire cords and rods used in pre-stressed concrete for buildings.
Kobe Steel produces a total of 130,000 tonnes of wire rods a month at the two mills, a Kobe Steel spokesman said.
